questions.text: Which of the following is a key advantage of Intra-Option Q-Learning over SMDP Q-Learning?
options: Intra-Option Q-Learning converges to the globally optimal policy, whereas SMDP Q-Learning only converges to locally optimal solutions

Intra-Option Q-Learning updates [IMAGE: /data/images/da5007_2026T1_ET_AN_p14_Im3.webp|inline] at every primitive step rather than only at option termination, resulting in more efficient use of experience, especially for long- duration options
Intra-Option Q-Learning eliminates the need for the termination function [IMAGE: /data/images/da5007_2026T1_ET_AN_p14_Im4.webp|inline]
Intra-Option Q-Learning learns only a single option, avoiding the need for a high-level policy
questions.correct_answer: Intra-Option Q-Learning updates [IMAGE: /data/images/da5007_2026T1_ET_AN_p14_Im3.webp|inline] at every primitive step rather than only at option termination, resulting in more efficient use of experience, especially for long- duration options
